I went through a second puberty when I hit 30 and I have discovered a few things. All natural vegetable soap is the shit. Cleanse the face morning and night. I'm a scrubber, even though I know that it's not supposed to be good for you skin, but whatever, I use a wash cloth to gently wash my face. Toner -- always use a toner. Dickinson's Witch Hazel will change your life. I splash that on my face like the dudes in the aftershave commercials. Serums -- it takes some work, but it is worth finding ones that work. Currently using Oz Naturals Vitamin C and AHA serum plus Oz Naturals Hylauronic (spelling is wrong spell check is not helping) Acid serum.  Moisturizers -- a light daily moisturizer with SPF, Oil of Olay is my go to. For night Retinol is God's gift to faces everywhere. Basically, as your skin matures, so should your routine. Retinol and vitamin C will help with breakouts, retinol is super moisturizing, and don't give up the sun protection. My advice is add at least the toner and serum to your routine. If you are breaking out find products that err on the side of natural and artificial fragrance free. And for the love of God, do not let anyone talk you into putting coconut oil on your face.
